column1: # What a run family holds beside its sites: the gate, the respawn town and the seeds. The
# herb family is written once per spellbook; every other family once, for any book.
# run
# A family with a seed patch type and no gate skill unlocks at the Farming level its
# cheapest crop plants from. The respawn town is the one the run prefers, if any.
# Camelot is a short run from Catherby, which this run reaches no other cheap way.
HERB
# 96 Magic for the spellbook's teleports, or 92 with a magic potion. Only the true level
# gates; the boost is advice.
HERB
# The four tree runs. Each tree category keeps its own travel chain rather than one ordered
# route, so the runs stay apart and the scheduler combines whichever fall due together. A
# "high level" tree run is not a fifth run: after the Falador elite diary that patch is
# disease-free and takes the magic saplings, while everywhere else plants yew.
# The best Farming experience in the game.
HARDWOOD
CALQUAT
# Falador respawn lands beside its tree patch, so this run prefers a different town than
# the herb run.
REGULAR_TREE
FRUIT_TREE
# The runs that are not a circuit of patches: hespori and seaweed, and the contract loop.
# Hespori is worth doing whenever it comes up: anima seeds, the bottomless bucket, and
# decent XP.
HESPORI
# One plant at a time, whose effect reaches every patch. The true level is 76; a garden pie
# boosts from 73.
ANIMA
# Spores plant at 23 Farming. 76 is a recommendation, not a gate: the run waits for an
# Attas anima plant, which needs 76. 73 is the garden-pie boost floor.
SEAWEED
# The contract loop. One stop, because everything happens inside the guild: claim from
# Guildmaster Jane, work whichever preplanted patch was asked for, replant. The true level
# is 65, boostable from 62 with a garden pie.
CONTRACT
